bento.alert.close: Label for a button that lets the user close an alert.
bento.alert.criticalIcon: Accessible name for the critical-severity icon in an alert.
bento.alert.highlightIcon: Accessible name for the highlight (informative) icon in an alert.
bento.alert.successIcon: Accessible name for the success icon in an alert.
bento.alert.warningIcon: Accessible name for the warning icon in an alert.
bento.allFiltersModal.activeFilters: Heading for filters that are currently applied.
bento.allFiltersModal.all: Tab or section label for the complete set of available filters.
bento.allFiltersModal.allFilters: Title of the modal used to view and manage all filters.
bento.allFiltersModal.applyAll: Label for a button that applies every selected filter.
bento.allFiltersModal.cancel: Label for a button that cancels the current action
bento.allFiltersModal.clear: Label for a button that clears the current filter selection.
bento.allFiltersModal.clearAll: Label for a button that clears every filter.
bento.allFiltersModal.noFiltersMatchThis: Empty-state message shown when a filter search returns no matching filters.
bento.allFiltersModal.otherFilters: Heading for filters that are available but not currently applied.
bento.allFiltersModal.searchBar: Accessible label for the filter search field.
bento.baseFilter.apply: Label for a button that applies the current filter selection.
bento.baseFilter.clear: Label for a button that clears the current filter selection.
bento.baseFilter.clearFilter: Label for a button that clears the %{function} filter.
bento.baseFilter.numberSelected: Status text showing how many items are selected. %{numberOfItemsSelected} is the number of selected items.
bento.baseFilter.reset: Label for a button that restores the current filter to its initial state.
bento.baseFilter.resetFilter: Label for a button that resets the %{function} filter to its default state.
bento.baseModal.ariaLabelFallback: Fallback accessible name for a modal dialog when no explicit label is provided.
bento.baseModal.close: Label for a button that closes a modal dialog.
bento.calendarMonth.nextMonth: Button label for moving the calendar view to the next month.
bento.calendarMonth.previousMonth: Button label for moving the calendar view to the previous month.
bento.calendarYear.nextYear: Button label for moving the calendar view to the next year.
bento.calendarYear.previousYear: Button label for moving the calendar view to the previous year.
bento.calendarYearSelector.selectYear: Accessible label for the control used to choose a calendar year.
bento.card.hideContent: Label for a button that collapses the extra content in a card.
bento.card.showContent: Label for a button that expands hidden content in a card.
bento.checkbox.optional: Text indicating that a form field is optional and not required to be filled.
bento.checkboxGroupFilter.all: Checkbox option that selects every value in a filter group.
bento.copy.copied: Will be displayed in a tooltip when a user clicks the copy icon to copy some text
bento.copy.copy: Will be displayed in a tooltip when a user hovers over a copy icon to let them know that clicking it will copy the text next to it
bento.dataGrid.filterBar: Used as label for a group of controls for filtering a list of records.
bento.dataGrid.gettingYourData: Loading status displayed while data-grid records are being retrieved.
bento.dataGrid.loading: Loading status displayed while the data grid is loading.
bento.dataGrid.noResults: Empty-state message shown when the data grid has no matching records.
bento.dataGrid.pagination: Used as label for a group containing pagination information and controls for a list of records.
bento.dataGridCellActions.copy: Will be displayed in a tooltip when a user hovers over a copy icon to let them know that clicking it will copy the text next to it
bento.dataGridColumns.rowActionsColumn: Accessible name for the data-grid column containing actions for each row.
bento.dataGridLazyLoad.loading: Loading status displayed while additional data-grid records are being retrieved.
bento.dataGridLazyLoad.noResults: Empty-state message shown when loading more data-grid records returns no results.
bento.datePicker.invalidDateFormat: Validation message shown when the entered date does not use the required format.
bento.datePicker.selectDate: Prompt shown in the date picker before the user chooses a date.
bento.dateRangeFilter.apply: Label for a button that lets the user apply the current date range.
bento.dateRangeFilter.reset: Label for a button that lets the user reset the current date range.
bento.dateRangePicker.apply: Label for a button that lets the user apply the current date range.
bento.dateRangePicker.cancel: Label for a button that cancels the current action
bento.dateRangePicker.invalidDateFormat: Validation message shown when a date-range value has an invalid date format.
bento.dateRangePickerCalendar.customRang: Option label for selecting a custom duration.
bento.dateRangePickerCalendar.dateFrom: Accessible label for the start-date field in a date-range picker.
bento.dateRangePickerCalendar.dateTo: Accessible label for the end-date field in a date-range picker.
bento.dateRangePickerCalendar.DD-MM-YYYY: Date format pattern shown to the user. Do not translate the format tokens.
bento.dateRangePickerCalendar.from: Field label for the from value in the date range picker range selector.
bento.dateRangePickerCalendar.invalidDat: Validation message shown when a date-range value has an invalid date format.
bento.dateRangePickerCalendar.lastMonth: Preset date-range option for the previous calendar month.
bento.dateRangePickerCalendar.lastSevenD: Preset date-range option for the previous seven days.
bento.dateRangePickerCalendar.MM-DD-YYYY: Date format pattern shown to the user. Do not translate the format tokens.
bento.dateRangePickerCalendar.selectedDa: Validation message shown when the selected date cannot be chosen.
bento.dateRangePickerCalendar.startDateM: Validation message shown when the date-range start date is after the end date.
bento.dateRangePickerCalendar.to: Field label for the to value in the date range picker range selector.
bento.dateRangePickerCalendar.YYYY-MM-DD: Date format pattern shown to the user. Do not translate the format tokens.
bento.dropdown.ariaLabelFallback: Fallback accessible name for a dropdown when no label is provided.
bento.dropdown.clearSearch: Label for a button that clears text entered in the dropdown search field.
bento.dropdownBaseTextbox.clearSearch: Label for a button that clears text entered in the dropdown search field.
bento.dropdownOptionsContainer.apply: Label for a button that applies the current selection in a dropdown.
bento.dropdownOptionsContainer.cancel: Label for a button that cancels the current action
bento.dropdownOptionsContainer.noOptions: Empty-state message shown when a dropdown search returns no matching options.
bento.fieldLabel.optional: Text indicating that a form field is optional and not required to be filled.
bento.fileUploader.browseFiles: Used as button label for a file upload widget which enables the user to select one or more files to be uploaded.
bento.fileUploader.fileExceedsSizeLimit: Will be displayed as input validation error message if at least one uploaded file is of a size larger than the maximum allowed file size.
bento.fileUploader.tooManyFiles: Will be displayed as input validation error message if the number of uploaded files is more than expected.
bento.fileUploader.youHaveExceededTheMax: Validation message shown after the user exceeds the maximum number of uploaded files. %{count} is the allowed file count.
bento.fileUploaderFileCard.cancel: Label for a button that cancels the current action
bento.fileUploaderFileCard.fileExceedsSi: Will be displayed as input validation error message if at least one uploaded file is of a size larger than the maximum allowed file size.
bento.fileUploaderFileCard.fileTypeMustB: Validation message that lists the file types accepted for an uploaded file. %{list} is the formatted list of accepted file types.
bento.fileUploaderFileCard.imageDimensio: Label indicating the file input does not meet the required dimensions
bento.fileUploaderFileCard.remove: Label for a button that removes the uploaded logo.
bento.fileUploaderFileCard.retry: Label for a button that retries a failed file upload.
bento.fileUploaderRestrictions.maxFileSi: File-upload requirement showing the maximum allowed file size. %{size} is the file-size limit.
bento.fileUploaderRestrictions.maxImageD: File-upload requirement showing the maximum allowed image dimensions. %{width} and %{height} are pixel dimensions.

bento.fileUploaderRestrictions.supported: File-upload requirement listing supported file types. %{list} is the formatted list of accepted file types.
bento.filterBar.clearFilters: Label for a button that clears the filters currently applied to a list.
bento.filterBar.filtersHaveBeenCleared: Confirmation message shown after all filters are cleared.
bento.filterBar.filtersHaveBeenReset: Confirmation message shown after filters are restored to their default values.
bento.filterBar.resetFilters: Label for a button that restores filters to their default values.
bento.filterBar.undo: Label for a button that reverses the previous filter-bar action.
bento.inputField.ariaLabelFallback: Fallback accessible name for a text input when no label is provided.
bento.modalFullscreenPage.close: Label for a button that closes a full-screen modal page.
bento.paginationContext.pageNumber: Pagination status showing the current page. %{page} is the current page number.

bento.paginationControls.navigateToThePr: Used as label for a button which triggers fetching of records for the previous page (if available).

bento.timeline.cancel: Label for a button that cancels the current action
bento.timelineItem.showLess: Used as label for a button which hides parts of a large block of content.
bento.timelineItem.showMore: Used as label for a button which reveals a specific amount of hidden content.
bento.toastItem.dismiss: Label for a button that lets the user dismiss the current toast.
